options.name: auto_recovery
options.description: Enables/Disables auto recovery on platforms that support disable timers are not modifiable with this attribute mutually exclusive with auto_recovery_reload_delay

options.name: auto_recovery_reload_delay
options.description: Manages auto-recovery reload-delay timer in seconds mutually exclusive with auto_recovery

options.name: delay_restore
options.description: manages delay restore command and config value in seconds

options.name: delay_restore_interface_vlan
options.description: manages delay restore interface-vlan command and config value in seconds not supported on all platforms

options.name: delay_restore_orphan_port
options.description: manages delay restore orphan-port command and config value in seconds not supported on all platforms

options.name: pkl_dest
options.description: Destination (remote) IP address used for peer keepalive link pkl_dest is required whenever pkl options are used.

options.name: pkl_src
options.description: Source IP address used for peer keepalive link

options.name: pkl_vrf
options.description: VRF used for peer keepalive link The VRF must exist on the device before using pkl_vrf. (Note) 'default' is an overloaded term: Default vrf context for pkl_vrf is 'management'; 'pkl_vrf: default' refers to the literal 'default' rib.

options.name: role_priority
options.description: Role priority for device. Remember lower is better.

options.name: state
options.description: Manages desired state of the resource

options.name: system_priority
options.description: System priority device.  Remember they must match between peers.
